title: Argentina
goal: Read about the internal succession of Argentina's military juntas (Videla, Viola, Galtieri, Bignone) and how Galtieri's 1982 Falklands gamble finally brought the regime down -- not the coup or the disappearances, already covered.

items: State how many juntas and presidents succeeded each other, 1976-1983.
Explain what happened to Roberto Eduardo Viola.
Explain why Galtieri ordered the 1982 Falklands invasion.
Use acto seguido to sequence closely-following events.
